label: Calm
description: Steady under pressure; does not panic.

label: Analytical
description: Breaks problems into parts and studies them.

label: Compassionate
description: Cares deeply about others' suffering.

label: Ambitious
description: Wants to rise higher and achieve more.

label: Proud
description: Strong sense of self-worth and legacy.

label: Humble
description: Does not seek praise or status.

label: Reserved
description: Quiet; shares little unless necessary.

label: Charismatic
description: Draws people in with presence and words.

label: Stoic
description: Endures hardship without complaint.

label: Impulsive
description: Acts before thinking; fast decisions.

label: Reckless
description: Ignores danger to reach a goal.

label: Cautious
description: Checks every risk before acting.

label: Curious
description: Seeks knowledge and new experiences.

label: Suspicious
description: Questions others' motives by default.

label: Loyal
description: Stands by people and commitments.

label: Independent
description: Prefers to work alone.

label: Protective
description: Defends those they care for fiercely.

label: Vengeful
description: Seeks payback for wrongs done to them or loved ones.

label: Idealistic
description: Believes in a better world and works toward it.

label: Cynical
description: Expects the worst from people and situations.

label: Disciplined
description: Follows strict routines and training regimens.

label: Playful
description: Finds humor and lightness even in hard times.

label: Sarcastic
description: Uses biting humor to deflect or criticize.

label: Patient
description: Waits for the right moment without rushing.

label: Stubborn
description: Refuses to change course once decided.

label: Adaptable
description: Adjusts quickly to changing circumstances.

label: Manipulative
description: Influences others to serve their own ends.

label: Honest
description: Values truth even when inconvenient.

label: Secretive
description: Keeps information close and reveals little.

label: Competitive
description: Measures self against others and strives to win.

label: Fearful
description: Hesitant and anxious in dangerous situations.

label: Courageous
description: Faces danger despite fear.

label: Self-sacrificing
description: Puts others' safety before their own.

label: Detached
description: Emotionally distant; observes rather than engages.

label: Empathetic
description: Feels others' emotions as their own.

label: Arrogant
description: Overestimates their own ability and importance.

label: Insecure
description: Doubts their own worth and choices.

label: Optimistic
description: Expects things to turn out well.

label: Pessimistic
description: Expects things to turn out poorly.

label: Perfectionist
description: Demands flawlessness from self and others.
